metadata.description: Terminal harness and UI design agents, knowledge skills, and entry commands.

plugins.name: termcraft
plugins.description: Terminal craft: a specialist agent pair (tui-designer, harness-architect) plus four skills — two knowledge skills, tui-design (theme bank with light/dark palettes, banner font, glyph sets, image→glyph rendering, previews) and cli-harness (digest a codebase or shell script into a finite-state process model and generate or audit a guided, resumable operator CLI harness, verified in a pty), and two entry skills, /termcraft:design and /termcraft:harness, that dispatch to the agents.
